note: The family build's face set (Sani 2026-11-22): YuNet 2023mar (MIT) + SFace 2021dec (Apache 2.0), both OpenCV Zoo, and CAM++ (Apache 2.0, 3D-Speaker) in half precision. The school build keeps public/models/manifest.json.

spk.note: 3dspeaker_speech_campplus_sv_en_voxceleb_16k in fp16: embeddings within cos 0.99995 of fp32 on 60 clips

cfg_note: SFace (int8) sits on another scale than the school's R50. Frames are scored by their MEDIAN (frameAgg 'median'), not the best 3, which kept climbing while a stranger stayed in view. In the app's own pipeline some look-alike strangers still reach 0.56-0.63 against a child's prints (22 Nov test), so: on the face alone only at 0.70 and up (earlyAccept, at least 4 frames) or 0.68 at the end of the capture (faceAccept); from 0.50 (faceMaybe) only when the child's voice agrees (voiceAccept 0.55); margin 0.07; voice-weight gaps 0.066/0.21.
